title: MetaMask Extension June 2022 security depth
notes: Candidate-only review bundle for two material MetaMask Extension security disclosures. Canonical publication is prohibited until separate manual review and canonical PR.

events.title: MetaMask Extension critical clickjacking vulnerability disclosed
events.description: MetaMask reported a critical Extension-only clickjacking vulnerability that could render the wallet UI as a hidden layer over a malicious site and trick users into revealing private data or sending crypto-assets. MetaMask awarded the reporting team a $120,000 bounty and stated that Extension 10.14.6 and later were protected.
events.notes: Month precision is intentional: the reviewed first-party source establishes a June 2022 disclosure but not one defensible exact public disclosure day. MetaMask reported no known exploitation before the patch, but WLR does not convert that into a stronger funds_affected=no claim.

events.title: Demonic vulnerability exposed MetaMask Extension recovery phrases on disk
events.description: Halborn disclosed CVE-2022-32969, known as Demonic, in which browser session-restore behavior could cache an imported Secret Recovery Phrase to disk in plaintext under specified conditions. MetaMask Extension versions before 10.11.3 were affected; MetaMask implemented mitigations in 10.11.3 and later, and MetaMask Mobile was not affected.
events.notes: Halborn's 2022-06-15 coordinated public disclosure supplies the event date. NVD rates CVE-2022-32969 at CVSS 3.1 5.9 MEDIUM and records MetaMask versions before 10.11.3 as affected. First-party MetaMask reporting explicitly excludes MetaMask Mobile. No confirmed funds-loss statement is established, so funds_affected remains unknown.

evidence.title: MetaMask Security Monthly: June 2022
evidence.notes: First-party MetaMask security report. Supports the Extension-only critical clickjacking vulnerability, protected version 10.14.6+, the Demonic disk-caching issue, mitigation in 10.11.3+, and explicit exclusion of MetaMask Mobile from Demonic.

evidence.title: Halborn MetaMask Demonic Vulnerability Discovery
evidence.notes: Primary researcher disclosure published 2022-06-15 after coordinated mitigation work. Describes plaintext Secret Recovery Phrase persistence through browser session-restore behavior and the attacker's remote/physical access path.

evidence.title: CVE-2022-32969 Detail
evidence.notes: NVD enrichment records CVSS 3.1 score 5.9 MEDIUM and MetaMask versions up to but excluding 10.11.3 as affected, with the MetaMask 10.11.2-to-10.11.3 comparison referenced as a patch boundary.
